label: Uneasy calm
summary: The Iran war set the tone again. Tankers were hit in the Strait of Hormuz, Iran targeted US radars in Bahrain, and damage to its own grid forced Tehran to ration electricity. A Russian strike on Kryvyi Rih killed two and wounded 60, Israeli strikes continued in Gaza, and 11 people died in violence around a Mexican cartel leader's capture. COP31 went into a second day of overtime with no agreement on fossil fuels. Argentina's country risk topped 1,000 points. A factory fire in Indonesia left three dead and 36 missing. Science gave some relief: a CRISPR trial halved bad cholesterol with one injection, a claimed proof of the Riemann hypothesis drew scrutiny, and nations agreed to draft rules for autonomous weapons. The weighted formula gave 41; no editorial adjustment.
